text:
sasha: Hey @people-ops - quick heads up. Im starting a new medication thats causing daytime drowsiness and occasional light sensitivity. My doc recommended a phased hybrid schedule (3 remote days, 2 quiet-office days) and avoiding overnight oncall for 8 weeks. Also, my desk neighbor has been using heavy scented products; its making symptoms worse. Can we set up an accommodation? I can share the note privately.

lina: Thanks for flagging this, @sasha. Please DM the medical note to @jamie and I. We can scope reasonable adjustments: temporary desk move, hybrid schedule, and oncall exemption. Not a performance issue.

jamie: Ill open an intake record and mark it private. Sasha, if you DM the note well confirm dates and required changes. Also need to know which oncall rotations fall in the 8-week window so we can reassign nights.

sasha: DMd the note. Preferred effective dates: 2026-09-14 to 2026-11-09. For oncall, Im scheduled for night rotation 9/21-9/27 and 10/19-10/25. Happy to do daytime triage but prefer nights routed to backups.

people-ops-bot: Intake created  ID #4871  status: awaiting manager acknowledgment.

lina: Acknowledged @people-ops-bot. Ill accept in the HR system and initiate coverage plan. @joan-talent FYI - Sasha was slated to run the 9/23 onsite interview panel. Can we reassign that interviewer?

joan-talent: Thanks for the ping. I can take the panel or assign @rafael. Sasha, would you be comfortable doing the debrief async? We can also move the candidate to a remote loop if needed.

sasha: Id prefer to be remote for that day and do async debriefs. I can leave a debrief checklist and score guidance in the candidate doc.

sam-facilities: @jamie @lina Sam from facilities here. We can offer a temporary desk reassignment to a low-traffic zone and install an air purifier. If the neighbors scent persists, we can put up a polite desk note and work with People Ops on enforcement. ETA for move is 48-72 hours from approval.

jamie: Great. Action list Ill track: 1) Intake #4871 filed (done) 2) Manager acknowledgement (lina) 3) Desk reassignment & purifier (facilities) 4) Oncall reassignments for night rotations (lina/eng-leads) 5) Interview coverage (joan) 6) 2-week check-in scheduled with Sasha (people-ops).

lina: Ill coordinate oncall swaps with the eng leads and add a calendar blocking for 9/20 as a handoff day. Also clarifying: performance expectations remain unchanged; we'll document temporary process changes so Sasha isn't penalized.

sasha: Thank you. Appreciate the clarity on performance. One more ask: could standup be moved to a slightly later time on my quiet-office days? Morning light and noise are rough for me.

jamie: Sure — we can propose a 10:30 standup on Sashas quiet days and keep 9:30 on others. Lina, can you confirm with the team before we finalize?

lina: Will do. Ill post in #eng to propose the temporary standup shift on those dates and ask for feedback. Ill also approve the desk move now that Facilities has availability.

joan-talent: Confirmed Ill take the 9/23 panel and handle onsite logistics. Sasha, please drop your async debrief checklist in the candidate doc today if you can.

sasha: Will add the checklist this afternoon. Quick note: please do not share medical details widely; mark the accommodation as private.

jamie: Noted, Sasha. All documentation will be private and access-limited. Scheduling: I set a 2-week cadence check-in on 2026-09-28 and a final review on 2026-11-02.

people-ops-bot: Intake #4871 updated  status: awaiting facilities scheduling.

sam-facilities: Desk move scheduled for 2026-09-16 14:00-15:00. Air purifier delivered.

lina: Thanks everyone. Sasha, let us know at any time if adjustments still arent working. This is a collaborative process. :heart:

sasha: Thanks all  really appreciate how quickly this was handled.
